open_questions.gap: The person who gives final approval of the brief on the Voreas side is still unnamed: Nikos says it is between himself and Stella and has promised to confirm within the week. Requested in Message 1, chased in Message 3, still open in Message 5.

internal_conflicts.note: Explicit supersession by the same party: Nikos (Voreas) reports in Message 4 that the launch date is finally locked at 14 Φεβρουαρίου and calls it οριστικό, replacing the board's 31 Ιανουαρίου request from Message 2. Message 3 (Eleni) questioned the 31/1 date as very tight and asked for definitive confirmation. History kept for the position trail; no open question needed.

extraction_notes: Message 2 mentions an earlier launch plan ('μεγάλη αλλαγή από τον Μάρτιο'), and Message 4 calls it 'το αρχικό πλάνο'. No date or year is given for it, so it is not extracted as an item.
Message 5 (Eleni, agency side) states that a revised plan is being prepared. This is an agency-side action, not client brief content, so it is not extracted.
